description: This receiver fetches stats from an SNMP enabled host using a [golang snmp client](https://github.com/gosnmp/gosnmp). Metrics are collected based upon different configurations in the config file. Optionally, SNMP notifications are received over UDP and emitted as logs.
name: snmpreceiver

snmp_traps_engine_cache_entries.description: Number of authenticated SNMPv3 engines currently tracked in the notification engine cache.

snmp_traps_engine_cache_expirations.description: Number of authenticated SNMPv3 engine cache entries removed after the configured idle timeout.

snmp_traps_engine_limit_rejections.description: Number of SNMP notifications rejected because the engine cache reached capacity.
